Fleet.title: Work in a Great Car with Vonco Partners
Fleet.description: We are looking for drivers who love the road as much as we do. We have about 100 cars for every taste: from reliable workhorses like the **Skoda Fabia** to comfortable **Toyota Camry**, **Lexus**, and even **Tesla**. Most cars are modern hybrids to help you spend less on fuel and earn more.

CarFleet.title: Taxi Car Rental, Leasing and Lease-to-Own in Poland
CarFleet.description:
Taxi Car Rental in Poland
If you do not have your own car, Vonco Partners provides taxi-ready vehicles for Uber, Bolt, and Free Now with transparent terms.

Available Cars
Our fleet includes economy and comfort-class models. Most vehicles are hybrids, helping drivers reduce fuel costs and improve net earnings.

Leasing and Lease-to-Own
For long-term cooperation, we offer leasing and lease-to-own options so you can gradually pay toward ownership under clear terms.

What Is Included
• taxi car rental with simple onboarding
• manager support and platform connection help
• option to work with a rental car or your own car
• official cooperation formats

Start Fast
Send us a request and we will match a car to your work model and help you start quickly.

krakow.name: Krakow
krakow.demandText: Krakow is one of the strongest taxi markets in Poland, with year-round demand from airport transfers, tourism, and office traffic.
krakow.seoText: Taxi driver work in Krakow combines city rides, airport transfers, and tourism demand, making it a solid location for stable operations.
krakow.earningsText: Estimated gross monthly income for a taxi driver in Krakow: 7,000-12,000 PLN, depending on schedule, seasonality, app mix, and costs.
krakow.hotspots: Krakow Glowny, Old Town, Kazimierz, Airport Balice
krakow.districts: Podgorze, Nowa Huta, Krowodrza, Pradnik Czerwony

katowice.demandText: Katowice and the Silesian metro area provide steady taxi demand from intercity routes, office districts, and events.
katowice.seoText: In Katowice and the wider Silesian area, taxi demand stays consistent due to intercity mobility, business routes, and event traffic.
katowice.earningsText: Estimated gross monthly income for a taxi driver in Katowice: 6,500-11,000 PLN, depending on driving hours, route mix, and cooperation model.

zakopane.name: Zakopane
zakopane.demandText: Zakopane offers high seasonal taxi demand, especially on weekends, during holidays, and across tourism-heavy periods.

zakopane.earningsText: Estimated gross monthly income for a taxi driver in Zakopane: 6,000-13,000 PLN, typically higher during peak tourism season.
zakopane.hotspots: Krupowki, Gubalowka transfers, Bus station, Hotel zones
zakopane.districts: Krupowki area, Olcza, Harenda, Koscielisko direction
